Mac_DiskLow: Disk almost full: less than 10% free.
Mac_SugNote: Suggestions only: nothing is deleted automatically. Selected files go to the Trash and can be restored.
Mac_SugRoots: Folders to scan (one per line, %HOME% allowed):
Mac_ProcSubtitle: Which apps use CPU and RAM; end or restart apps
Mac_PurgeHint: Runs macOS's purge command to flush the disk cache. macOS asks for an administrator password. Memory of running apps is untouched; to free it for good, end apps you don't use.
Mac_Forced: ({count} processes had to be forced to stop.)
Restart_Confirm:
Restart {app}?

The app is quit as with Cmd+Q (it may ask to save; the first time macOS asks to let Manager Mac control the app); if it hasn't quit after 10 seconds it is forced to stop, then reopened.
